packages.title: Aurora Noir
packages.summary: A deep blue-black research palette with cool mint accents and crisp scientific status colors.
packages.details: Aurora Noir keeps the canvas quiet while giving active controls, references, and research states a restrained northern-light glow. It is designed for long evening sessions without flattening the hierarchy between conversation, evidence, and tools.
features: Low-glare blue-black surfaces for long research sessions
Mint focus and navigation accents without neon saturation
Clearly separated evidence, warning, success, and failure colors
Aurora syntax palette for code, data, Lean, and Markdown

packages.title: Arctic Daylight
packages.summary: A crisp cool-light theme with blue-gray structure, clean white surfaces, and teal focus accents.
packages.details: Arctic Daylight is built for bright rooms and high-density review. Cool gray-blue separators make complex panes easy to parse, while the white working surface stays clean without losing the distinction between controls, drawers, and evidence regions.
features: Crisp daylight surfaces for bright working environments
Blue-gray structural layers for complex pane layouts
Teal focus cues with accessible light-background status colors
High-contrast daylight syntax colors across supported Study files

packages.title: Cobalt Night
packages.summary: A focused midnight-blue theme with luminous cobalt controls and cool scientific accents.
packages.details: Cobalt Night uses layered navy surfaces to keep complex workspaces legible without turning black. Bright cobalt focus cues and carefully separated state colors make it particularly effective for dense evidence tables and long tool-driven sessions.
features: Layered navy surfaces for dense technical workspaces
Luminous cobalt focus cues and selection states
Cool status palette with readable warning and failure contrast
Cobalt syntax hierarchy for dense technical editing

packages.title: Ember Slate
packages.summary: A warm charcoal theme with copper accents, soft paper text, and grounded research-state colors.
packages.details: Ember Slate trades the usual blue-gray developer palette for warm mineral surfaces and a precise copper accent. The restrained warmth makes manuscripts and long explanations comfortable while preserving crisp borders and visible scientific state changes.
features: Warm charcoal surfaces that reduce cold-screen fatigue
Copper navigation accents with soft high-contrast text
Balanced status colors for proofs, warnings, and counterexamples
Warm syntax colors tuned for long writing and review sessions

packages.title: Paper Sage
packages.summary: A warm light theme inspired by archival paper, with sage navigation and ink-like typography.
packages.details: Paper Sage is a daylight palette for reading, reviewing evidence, and drafting manuscripts. Warm neutral surfaces avoid stark white glare, while sage accents and ink-like text keep the workspace calm and unmistakably structured.
features: Warm paper surfaces for daylight reading and manuscript work
Ink-like body text with calm sage navigation accents
Accessible research-state colors tuned for light backgrounds
Ink-and-sage syntax palette for manuscripts, data, and proofs

packages.title: Plum Graphite
packages.summary: A sophisticated graphite-and-plum palette with lavender focus cues and soft neutral text.
packages.details: Plum Graphite gives TheoX a quieter editorial character. Graphite foundations prevent the purple family from becoming decorative, while lavender accents make navigation, references, and active research controls easy to find.
features: Graphite foundations with restrained plum depth
Lavender focus cues for navigation and active controls
Soft neutral typography for editorial and manuscript work
Plum-and-lavender syntax hierarchy for code and formal text
